capabilities: scan the vault for attachment files no note references
show a confirmation list with a checkbox per candidate file
delete candidates to Obsidian trash, system trash, or permanently
scope cleaning by folders, exclusions, and file extensions
abort or flag candidates when reference detection is uncertain
extras: Desktop only; manual installation via npm build is the only supported method; the README states the plugin was developed entirely by Claude Opus 5 and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin is inspired by oz-clear-unused-images-obsidian. It was developed to address a few problems left unsolved by its predecessor
motivation: The author built it to fix problems left unsolved by oz-clear-unused-images-obsidian: it is unmaintained, misses HTML references so it wrongly deletes attachments, and deletes with no chance to choose what stays.
problem: Pasted screenshots, clipped images and one-off diagrams stay in the vault after the notes that referenced them are gone, and Obsidian has no built-in way to find and remove them.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by oz-clear-unused-images-obsidian. It was developed to address a few problems left unsolved

summary: Attachment cleaner that scans the vault for files no note references and deletes them after showing a per-file confirmation list.
